name: armor_history_taxonomy_seed
purpose: Machine-readable seed for generating historical armor layers in Blender/Python.

period_chunks.representative_armor: hide wraps, bone/wood splints, fiber bindings
period_chunks.materials: skin, leather, rawhide, bark, wood, cordage
period_chunks.generator_use: Build as flexible wraps and strapped plates. Useful for primitive fantasy, tribal scouts, survival armor.

period_chunks.representative_armor: bronze helmets, linen cuirasses, leather scale, greaves, shields
period_chunks.shape_grammar: dome shells, conical shells, scale arrays, rimmed shields
period_chunks.generator_use: Good first hard-surface layer: simple helmets, greaves, chest shells, big readable shields.

period_chunks.representative_armor: corinthian helmet, muscle cuirass, linothorax, pteruges, scutum
period_chunks.shape_grammar: face shell, anatomical torso shell, skirt strips
period_chunks.generator_use: Use torso anatomy underneath; armor follows idealized chest/abdomen silhouette.

period_chunks.representative_armor: scale shirts, lamellar, spangenhelms, segmented helmets
period_chunks.generator_use: High repeat-count systems; perfect for procedural arrays and instancing.

period_chunks.representative_armor: mail hauberk, nasal helm, coif, chausses, kite shield
period_chunks.materials: iron rings, wool padding, leather straps
period_chunks.shape_grammar: chain mesh, cone/dome helmet, tapered shield
period_chunks.generator_use: Mail is a material/texture problem first, geometry problem second. Don't model every ring unless close-up.

period_chunks.representative_armor: gambeson, surcoat, great helm, chausses, poleyns, coat of plates
period_chunks.shape_grammar: padded slabs + boxy helm + hidden plate grid
period_chunks.generator_use: Great for clothing/armor overlap: underlayer, mail, surcoat, plate reinforcement.

period_chunks.representative_armor: bascinet, aventail, brigandine, gauntlets, arm harness, leg harness
period_chunks.materials: steel plate, mail, velvet/cloth shell, leather
period_chunks.generator_use: This is the hinge between textile craft and plate engineering. Extremely useful for your generator.

period_chunks.representative_armor: kabuto, menpo, do, sode, kote, kusazuri, haidate, suneate
period_chunks.materials: lacquered iron/leather, silk cord, textile, mail
period_chunks.shape_grammar: lamellar rows, cords, skirt panels, sleeve armor
period_chunks.generator_use: Procedural lacing and lamellar rows are the crown jewel here. Lots of visible construction logic.

period_chunks.representative_armor: armet, close helm, gorget, cuirass, pauldrons, couters, gauntlets, cuisses, sabatons
period_chunks.generator_use: Best tier for clean hard-surface mastery. Shape grammar is arcs, shells, flanges, slots, rivets.

period_chunks.representative_armor: buff coat, lobster-tail pot, breastplate, tassets, cavalry boots
period_chunks.generator_use: Armor becomes selective: torso/head protection over mobile textile/leather systems.

period_chunks.representative_armor: ballistic helmet, plate carrier, soft armor panels, riot armor, EOD suit
period_chunks.materials: aramid fabric, ceramic plates, polymer, nylon webbing
period_chunks.shape_grammar: modular pads, pouches, straps, foam shells
period_chunks.generator_use: Useful for tactical variants: MOLLE grids, panels, buckles, clips, velcro, foam padding.

shape_library.used_for: helmet bowl, skull cap, knee cap
shape_library.blender_proxy_method: UV sphere cut, solidify shell, bevel rim
curved mask plane with eye/mouth cutouts
ellipsoid chest shell with pectoral/ab ridges
two ellipsoid shells clipped at sides
cloth surface + quilt curves + seam channels
surface material with ring normal/displacement; close-up instanced torus rings

shape_library.used_for: scale shirt, scale skirt, dragonscale armor

shape_library.blender_proxy_method: textile vest + rivet heads in rows
cap shell with side wings and strap anchors
small overlapping plates on finger bones
flattened extruded shape with boss and rim

construction_methods.definition: parallel or diamond seam channels hold stuffing in place
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Use raised/indented curves on cloth surface; add stitch dash pattern along channel.

construction_methods.definition: edge strip covers raw cloth/leather edges
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Add narrow strip along robe/armor edge, usually slightly raised.

construction_methods.definition: cord passes through paired holes to bind plates or close garments
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Use bevelled curves crossing between holes; alternate over/under pattern.

construction_methods.definition: leather strap through metal frame with tongue
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Use strap_band + buckle_frame + tongue pin; add punched holes.

construction_methods.definition: metal fastener pins plate to leather/textile or plate to plate
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Use rivet_head instances on grid, seam, or edge line.

construction_methods.definition: metal plates rotate around pin or leather articulation
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Use cylinders as hinge barrels; add rotation constraints in rig mode.

construction_methods.definition: segmented plates overlap to allow bending
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Layer plates from top to bottom or front to back; keep visible lip.

construction_methods.definition: interlocked metal rings create flexible armor
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Texture/normal for mid distance; torus-ring grid only for hero closeups.
Array scales with row offset; upper row covers attachment of lower row.

construction_methods.definition: small plates tied edge-to-edge without full textile backing
construction_methods.blender_detail_instruction: Repeat rectangular plates and cord loops. Gorgeous, annoying, worth it.

chunk_templates.rig_animation_rule: Helmet rotates with head; aventail follows neck/shoulders with cloth-like lag.
Must preserve arm-lift clearance; do not fuse shoulder plates to torso.
Layer order matters: padding, mail/textile, hard plate, straps/accessories.
Hanging panels need independent motion or at least offset pivots.
Elbow gap is sacred. Break it and the model folds like wet cardboard.
Finger armor must be attached to finger bone chains, not painted on as one dead mitten unless stylized.
Knee and ankle require visible articulation breaks.
Model as separate cap with upper/lower articulation plates.
Toe bend needs segmented plates or a flexible boot crease.
Treat as prop with grip constraints and optional damage layers.

armor_entries.construction: segmented cap panels, quilt lines, chin tie
armor_entries.detail_notes: Add radial panel seams, sweat band, and slight compression under helmet.

armor_entries.blender_proxy: cut UV sphere shell + seam strips
armor_entries.detail_notes: Good low-tier primitive helmet base.
Add dents, hammer marks, patina only at hero tier.

armor_entries.construction: one-piece bowl with T-shaped face opening
armor_entries.detail_notes: Strong silhouette. Cheek guards curve inward.

armor_entries.construction: cone or spangen panels with nasal strip
armor_entries.detail_notes: Add riveted brow band and four panel seams.
Great procedural pattern: ribs first, plates second, rivets third.
Use shader/normal for most renders; torus rings around face edge for closeup.

armor_entries.construction: flat plates riveted into barrel helm
armor_entries.detail_notes: Boxy. Heavy. Beautifully unsubtle.
Attach aventail as mail skirt around lower edge.

armor_entries.construction: mail curtain fastened to helmet vervelles
armor_entries.detail_notes: Add small rivet/loop points around helmet rim.
Excellent silhouette for dark fantasy.

armor_entries.construction: T or Y shaped face opening
armor_entries.detail_notes: Reads ancient and medieval at once. Useful hybrid.
Use separate visor, bevor, cheek plates for rigging.
Hero-tier object. Needs hinge barrels and pin details.
Add shikoro neck guard as layered segmented plates.
Expression layer for intimidating face design.

armor_entries.construction: front/back collar plates, sometimes articulated lames
armor_entries.detail_notes: Important transition piece between head and torso.

armor_entries.construction: composite shell with suspension pads and straps
armor_entries.blender_proxy: dome shell + rail strips + pad blocks
armor_entries.detail_notes: Add NVG mount, side rails, chin strap in tactical tier.

armor_entries.construction: small padded cap sewn into garment
armor_entries.detail_notes: Under armor shoulder mass. Saves deformation from looking skeletal.
Use gravity-shaped cloth sim or static drape mesh.
Should hang from shoulder cord, not fuse to arm.
Must allow arm lift. Use 3-6 lames depending tier.
Lighter than full pauldron. Good for scout armor.

armor_entries.construction: small circular plate tied near armpit
armor_entries.detail_notes: Tiny but historically useful gap cover.
Riot/tactical silhouette.
This is the under-armor king. Build it before metal.

armor_entries.construction: layered linen body wrap with shoulder flaps
armor_entries.detail_notes: Add pteruges strips below waist.

armor_entries.construction: front/back anatomical plates joined at sides
armor_entries.detail_notes: Pecs and abs are stylized armor relief, not actual flesh.
Good medium tier. Add edge binding and punch holes.

armor_entries.construction: scales sewn or riveted to backing
armor_entries.detail_notes: Rows overlap downward. Use instancing or geometry nodes.

armor_entries.construction: small plates laced to each other
armor_entries.detail_notes: No full backing required. Visible cords are key.
Add split skirt for riding variants.
Useful heraldry/embroidery surface.

armor_entries.construction: internal plates riveted to outer garment
armor_entries.detail_notes: The plates are hidden. Rivets reveal the construction.

armor_entries.construction: small overlapping internal plates riveted to shell
armor_entries.detail_notes: Gorgeous textile-metal hybrid. Essential.

armor_entries.construction: shaped front plate with medial ridge optional
armor_entries.detail_notes: Add rolled edges, arm cutouts, neck cutout.

armor_entries.construction: shaped back plate tied/strapped to breastplate
armor_entries.detail_notes: Make separate object for don/doff logic.
Base for full plate suit.
Connects torso armor to tassets.

armor_entries.construction: laced plates or solid cuirass body
armor_entries.detail_notes: Use lacquer material and bright cord color in hero tier.
Armor becomes clothing-heavy here.
Pattern grid matters more than shiny material.
Animate strips separately for movement.
Use split front/back for mounted figures.
Key silhouette on full plate.
Use 4-8 hanging panels; cords visible.
For tactical/riot armor.

armor_entries.construction: fitted sleeve with quilting and points
armor_entries.detail_notes: Tie-on points anchor plate pieces.
Use sleeve opening and wrist taper.

armor_entries.construction: forearm tube, often two hinged halves
armor_entries.detail_notes: Add wrist and elbow edges, straps on inner side.
Usually tied/strapped to pauldron and couter.
Needs pivot clearance. Don't weld to forearm mesh.

armor_entries.construction: armored sleeve with sewn plates and mail
armor_entries.blender_proxy: cloth sleeve + plate strips + mail patches
armor_entries.detail_notes: Hybrid textile/metal surface, very generator-friendly.
Riot/sport/tactical variants.
Base layer for all gauntlets.
Simpler than finger gauntlet. Good low detail.

armor_entries.construction: flared cuff, knuckle plates, finger lames
armor_entries.blender_proxy: cuff shell + metacarpal plate + finger chains
armor_entries.detail_notes: A little machine cathedral for the hand.

armor_entries.construction: overlapping lames riveted to leather fingers
armor_entries.detail_notes: Use rig bone names: index_proximal, middle, distal.

armor_entries.construction: finger area covered by broad overlapping plates
armor_entries.detail_notes: Simpler rig, strong armored silhouette.
Pairs with kote.
Add palm texture and finger seam lines.

armor_entries.construction: front shin plate or hinged full lower-leg shell
armor_entries.detail_notes: Ancient greaves hug calf; plate greaves can be hinged two-piece.

armor_entries.construction: thigh plate strapped to arming garment
armor_entries.detail_notes: Usually connects visually to poleyn/knee.
Can cover foot top as mail shoe.
Hanging panels over thighs, not full tubes.

armor_entries.construction: vertical splints tied around lower leg
armor_entries.detail_notes: Great for procedural vertical strip arrays.

armor_entries.construction: knee cap with side wing and articulation lames
armor_entries.detail_notes: This is the knee lawgiver. Separate object, pivot-aware.
Useful for training, modern, low fantasy, under-armor.

armor_entries.construction: hard cap over foam pad with rear straps
armor_entries.detail_notes: Use exact knee pivot gap.

armor_entries.blender_proxy: foot shell + sole slab + seam curves

Keep sole leather visible.

armor_entries.construction: overlapping foot plates from ankle to toe
armor_entries.detail_notes: Pointy, broad, or bear-paw depending era/style.

armor_entries.construction: woven sole and straps, sometimes with shin armor above
armor_entries.detail_notes: Textile/cord modeling crosses into footwear craft.

armor_entries.blender_proxy: boot shell + tread blocks + lace curves
armor_entries.detail_notes: Use as modern tactical default.
Add rear grip/strap geometry if visible.

armor_entries.blender_proxy: shallow concave disk + rim + arm band
